resultSummary: FINAL: Chiefs 30, Raiders 27. Kansas City moves to 4-0.
headline: Chiefs 30, Raiders 27: Kansas City rallies late to stay unbeaten at 4-0
whyCareReason: Mahomes leads a 4th-quarter comeback in Las Vegas as Chiefs join Minnesota as the only 4-0 teams in the NFL.
teaser: Sunday 4 October, Allegiant Stadium. Chiefs 30, Raiders 27. Kansas City 4-0.
story: Patrick Mahomes engineered a late fourth-quarter touchdown drive as the Kansas City Chiefs edged the Las Vegas Raiders 30-27 at Allegiant Stadium. The win moves the Chiefs to 4-0, standing alongside the Minnesota Vikings as the NFL's only undefeated squads through four weeks. Earlier in the late window, Minnesota ground out a 15-10 defensive battle over Miami to keep their perfect slate, while San Francisco defeated Denver 24-14 and Seattle topped the Chargers 30-23. On Sunday night, Carolina surprised Detroit 32-26 for their maiden win.
stakes: AFC West leadership and preservation of a perfect 4-0 record.
rivalryAngle: Historic AFC West rivalry produces another one-score finish in Las Vegas.
